newsitem.title: USA: New York City says Bear, Stearns wins taxable debt.
newsitem.headline: New York City says Bear, Stearns wins taxable debt.

text.p: New York City, which is selling almost $1 billion of debt on Wednesday, awarded Bear, Stearns & Co nearly $136 million of taxable bonds, which will be sold domestically, said a city official.
The official, who declined to be named, said that the company's winning bid was 6.506 percent, beating out the next highest bidder, which was Prudential Securities at 6.514 percent.

"We'll be selling it domestically," said the city official, explaining that New York City got 10 bids for the issue, with Citicorp Securities and Goldman, Sachs & Co offering to sell at least part of the debt in Europe.
The city earlier Wednesday sold $834 million of tax-exempt, general obligation bonds through a syndicate headed by Bear Stearns.
